/about.title: About — Eduardo Pinillos · Independent product builder
/about.description: Eduardo Pinillos is an independent product builder based in Portugal, born in Lima. Building iOS and Mac apps alone, slow, on purpose since 2008.

/dimmly.title: Dimmly — Task manager & habit tracker for iOS and Mac · Pinillos Lab
/dimmly.description: Dimmly is a task manager and habit tracker for iOS and macOS. Color-coded lists, alarms, streaks, notes, checklists, and a built-in Scoreboard.

/percha.title: Percha — Wardrobe OS for iOS · Pinillos Lab
/percha.description: Percha is a quiet wardrobe OS for iOS. See what you own, what you wear, what you don’t. Works entirely on-device, no account required.

/solid.title: Solid — Minimal gym tracker for iOS · Pinillos Lab
/solid.description: Solid is a gym tracker for iOS that gets out of your way. No AI coach, no social feed, no subscription. Just your routine, your sets, and a rest timer.

/gridborne.title: Gridborne — Turn-based strategy game for iOS · Pinillos Lab
/gridborne.description: Gridborne is a turn-based strategy game played on a 7×7 grid. Quiet rules, deep tactics. Built for short, satisfying matches.

/wealth-square.title: Wealth Square — Native Mac net-worth tracker (coming soon) · Pinillos Lab
/wealth-square.description: Wealth Square is a native Mac app for tracking net worth. Currently in development — not ready to show yet.

/dummo.title: Dummo — Turn screen recordings into promo videos for iOS and Mac · Pinillos Lab
/dummo.description: Dummo turns a plain screen recording into a polished promo video. Wrap it in a device frame, add taps and auto-zoom, then export App Store previews, Reels, and Stories. iOS and macOS.

/takekit.title: TakeKit — Teleprompter camera for iOS · Pinillos Lab
/takekit.description: TakeKit is a teleprompter camera for creators, coaches, and founders. Write your script, hit record, and read from an on-screen guide only you can see — your exported video is always clean. No account, one-time Pro purchase.

/contact.title: Contact — Pinillos Lab
/contact.description: Get in touch with Eduardo Pinillos about a product idea, a collaboration, or feedback.

/privacy.title: Privacy — Pinilloslab.com
/privacy.description: Privacy policy for pinilloslab.com. No cookies, no analytics, no trackers. Fonts and scripts are self-hosted.

/dimmly/privacy.title: Dimmly — Privacy policy · Pinillos Lab
/dimmly/privacy.description: Privacy policy for Dimmly. No accounts, no tracking, no analytics. Your tasks and habits stay on your device and sync privately through your iCloud account.

/percha/privacy.title: Percha — Privacy policy · Pinillos Lab
/percha/privacy.description: Privacy policy for Percha. No accounts, no tracking, no analytics. Your wardrobe data stays on your device and syncs privately through your iCloud account.

/solid/privacy.title: Solid — Privacy policy · Pinillos Lab
/solid/privacy.description: Privacy policy for Solid. No accounts, no tracking, no analytics. Your workout data stays on your device and syncs privately through your iCloud account.

/gridborne/privacy.title: Gridborne — Privacy policy · Pinillos Lab
/gridborne/privacy.description: Privacy policy for Gridborne. No data collection, no tracking. The game runs entirely on your device, offline.

/dummo/privacy.title: Dummo — Privacy policy · Pinillos Lab
/dummo/privacy.description: Privacy policy for Dummo. No data collected, no tracking, no analytics. Your recordings and projects stay on your device and sync privately through your iCloud account.

/takekit/privacy.title: TakeKit — Privacy policy · Pinillos Lab
/takekit/privacy.description: Privacy policy for TakeKit. No accounts, no tracking, no analytics. Speech recognition runs on your device; your scripts and takes stay on your device and sync privately through your iCloud account.

trovelo.about: Private travel planner for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Plan trips day by day, track expenses in dual currency, keep your itinerary in your pocket. No account, no ads.

dimmly.about: Task manager and habit tracker for iOS and macOS. Color-coded lists, alarms, streaks, notes, checklists, and a built-in Scoreboard. Free for 5 lists, one-time upgrade for unlimited.

percha.about: Wardrobe OS for iOS. See what you own, what you wear, what you don't. Works entirely on-device — no account required.

solid.about: Gym tracker for iOS that gets out of your way. No AI coach, no social feed, no subscription. Just your routine, your sets, and a rest timer.

gridborne.about: Turn-based strategy game played on a 7x7 grid. Quiet rules, deep tactics. Built for short, satisfying matches. Offline single-player with Game Center leaderboards.

wealth-square.about: Native Mac app for tracking net worth. Currently in development.

dummo.about: Turn a plain screen recording into a polished promo video. Wrap it in a realistic device frame, add tap indicators and auto-zoom, then export App Store previews, Reels, and Stories. Free with a one-time Dummo Pro upgrade.

takekit.about: Teleprompter camera for iOS. Write your script, hit record, and read from an on-screen guide only you can see — the exported video is always clean. Speech-paced auto-scroll, takes grouped by script, clean crops for Reels, TikTok, Shorts. Free with a one-time TakeKit Pro upgrade.
